operational_definition: Review-derived composite proxy for product market success / traction

volume.source_signal: review_count (total number of scraped reviews for product)
volume.scaling: min-max normalized to [0, 1] within category using pre-cutoff bounds

rating.scaling: min-max normalized to [0, 1] within category using pre-cutoff bounds

velocity.source_signal: review accumulation rate over commercial lifespan
velocity.scaling: min-max normalized to [0, 1] within category using pre-cutoff bounds

zero_reviews_behavior: Products with <5 reviews excluded during dataset construction (survivorship constraint)
